name: Image Studio
description: Generate a picture from a prompt, then retouch it on real layers. Keep the prompts, models and finished images together on your PC.
alt: Image Studio’s Create workspace with a generated coastal landscape
summary: Turn a sentence into a picture, then edit it layer by layer on your PC.

name: GlideYT
description: Leave the video on the big screen. Search YouTube or choose a recommended video on Android, then control playback on your laptop over home Wi-Fi.
alt: GlideYT on Android showing the search, playback and volume controls
summary: Use your Android phone as a YouTube remote for your Windows laptop.

name: Rillboard
description: Draw on editable boards, plot equations as you type, and explore calculus with an offline symbolic calculator.
alt: Rillboard’s Windows workspace showing the drawing toolbar and the Start drawing and My boards buttons
summary: Draw, graph, and calculate offline on Windows or Linux.
